digest.component_or_area: live Jira DC provenance oracle / inbound reconcile test
propositions: The provenance test greps the raw Jira key (RBJNAZV-1) against json.dumps(ticket), but the created local id is lowercased (jira-rbjnazv-1) and case-sensitive, so the match cannot succeed.

The inbound create payload carries no raw Jira key except as a title fallback, and the DC binding lives in the binding store which list_tickets does not return, so a correct ticket is invisible to the assertion.
The fix asserts an exact match on ticket id equal to _jira_key_to_local_id(remote_key), asserts the binding store maps that local id to remote_key, and keeps creation_channel == 'jira'.
A pure unit test must pin that _jira_key_to_local_id lowercases and prefixes, so the derivation the live test depends on is verified independently of the harness.

This is a third oracle-authored-against-wrong-output-shape defect; the red was not evidence inbound is broken and a green must not be read as proof until assertions target what the inbound path writes.

After the oracle fix the inbound half of epic e369's headline AC is proven, but the outbound half (a local edit surfacing on the DC issue) remains unproven and the epic must not be closed on this run alone.
